title: Forest Plot JSON Schema

items.description: List of forest plot items. Each item represents a specific scenario to be compared to the baseline.

covariates.description: List of fixed covariates for this forest plot item.

name.description: Name of the covariate as defined in the model.

value.description: Fixed value for this covariate in this scenario.
